exercise.title: Name the notes up the neck
exercise.why: A position is easier to move when you know the name of the note it starts on, so naming notes up the neck is what lets you put any shape in any key.

cells.text: Press Start in the game below. The game names a note: find it in the part of the neck the game shows and play it, saying its name out loud. Practice until you stop counting up from the open string.
